properties.description: Generate approved reward batch CSV and save it to Blob Storage

activities.name: GenerateCsvToBlob
activities.description: Run Kusto query on approved/rejected reward batch transactions and save result as CSV to Blob

query.value:
let tx = transaction
| where initiativeId == '@{pipeline().parameters.initiativeId}'
| where merchantId == '@{pipeline().parameters.merchantId}'
| where rewardBatchId == '@{pipeline().parameters.rewardBatchId}'
| where rewardBatchTrxStatus in ('APPROVED','REJECTED')
| project
    tx_id = _id,
    tx_userId = userId,
    tx_trxChargeDate = trxChargeDate,
    tx_trxCode = trxCode,
    tx_effectiveAmountCents = effectiveAmountCents,
    tx_rewardAccruedRewardCents = rewardAccruedRewardCents,
    tx_additionalProductName = additionalProductName,
    tx_additionalProductGtin = additionalProductGtin,
    tx_invoiceDocNumber = invoiceDocNumber,
    tx_invoiceFilename = invoiceFilename,
    tx_rewardBatchTrxStatus = rewardBatchTrxStatus,
    tx_pointOfSaleId = pointOfSaleId;

let pos = point_of_sales
| project pos_id = _id, pos_franchiseName = franchiseName;

let dv = data_vault
| project dv_userId = _id, dv_fiscalCode = data;

tx
| join kind=leftouter pos on $left.tx_pointOfSaleId == $right.pos_id
| join kind=leftouter dv on $left.tx_userId == $right.dv_userId
| project
    ['Data e ora'] = format_datetime(tx_trxChargeDate, 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),
    Elettrodomestico = strcat(coalesce(tx_additionalProductName,''), iif(isempty(tostring(tx_additionalProductGtin)), '', strcat('\n', tostring(tx_additionalProductGtin)))),
    ['Codice Fiscale Beneficiario'] = tostring(dv_fiscalCode),
    ['ID transazione'] = tostring(tx_id),
    ['Codice sconto'] = tostring(tx_trxCode),
    ['Totale della spesa'] = toreal(tx_effectiveAmountCents) / 100.0,
    ['Sconto applicato'] = toreal(tx_rewardAccruedRewardCents) / 100.0,
    ['Numero fattura'] = tostring(tx_invoiceDocNumber),
    Fattura = tostring(tx_invoiceFilename),
    Stato = case(tx_rewardBatchTrxStatus=='TO_CHECK','Da esaminare',
                 tx_rewardBatchTrxStatus=='CONSULTABLE','Consultabile',
                 tx_rewardBatchTrxStatus=='SUSPENDED','Da controllare',
                 tx_rewardBatchTrxStatus=='APPROVED','Approvata',
                 tx_rewardBatchTrxStatus=='REJECTED','Esclusa',''),
    ['Punto vendita'] = tostring(pos_franchiseName)
| order by ['Data e ora'] asc
